headline:
روكستار تكشف ست مناطق
في ولاية Leonida
label: رسمي

reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: yes: rockstargames.com/VI 'Only in Leonida' read 11 Nov 16:38Z (six places and their descriptions); launch date on the same page re-read 11 Nov
reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: no Leonida places Reel in the ledger; episode 2 of the series Mohammad ordered
reel_check.ANGLE before lines: yes: hook six places Rockstar shows; why now 7 days to launch; for players here the state they will play in; payoff the date
reel_check.STORY TYPE explainer: yes: each place with Rockstar's own description, attributed once
reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: «روكستار تكشف ست مناطق في ولاية Leonida. أشهرها Vice City، عاصمة الشمس والمرح. جزر Leonida Keys بمياهها الجميلة والخطرة. مستنقعات Grassrivers موطن التماسيح. الساحل المنسي في Port Gellhorn. مصفاة السكر في Ambrosia. حديقة Mount Kalaga للصيد والطرق الوعرة. تصدر في 19 نوفمبر.» No line opens on و
reel_check.STORY: names: yes: روكستار غيمز (Rockstar Games) in the credit from frame 0, روكستار in the lines; places and the game in English as Rockstar writes them
reel_check.SENSITIVE: yes, nothing sensitive: the refinery, swamps and coast only; no strip club, bikers or weapons shown or named (Rockstar copy mentions them; left out)
reel_check.SOUND: footage sound or bed with reason: yes: Trailer 1 music stem from 11.4 s (music_only), no speech in 11.4 to 37 s (transcript: speech at 6.5 to 10.5 and from 58.4)
reel_check.PICTURE: footage first: yes: Rockstar's Trailer 1 (IGN 3840 copy) for Vice City, Keys and Grassrivers; Rockstar's own labelled stills for Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga, which the trailers do not name
reel_check.PICTURE: not the same picture as the las: yes: picture: Vice City beach from the air (Trailer 1); none of the last five used Trailer 1
